design_probes.design_claim: One official persistent-async invocation collects final and intermediate Oracle sources, updates only IDM over active replay, publishes a completed schema-4 IDM checkpoint, reloads it, and reaches the first action consumer.
design_probes.necessary_capability: The production phase, source-plan, replay, trainer, checkpoint, and first-consumer owners compose while the Planner update remains inactive.
design_probes.minimal_case: One CPU environment, three iterations, twelve main windows per iteration, twenty intermediate Oracle identities, replay capacity 96, and one IDM update per iteration.
preserved_production_owners: FADA phase resolver and source plan
schema-4 checkpoint writer and strict reader
simplifications: three iterations preserve replay creation and later consumption
external Oracle loader and simulator collector adapters only
design_probes.falsifier: Any student rollout, missing Oracle identity, zero replay activation, Planner loss/update, mixed optimizer owner, incomplete checkpoint, strict-load failure, non-finite first action, lifecycle leak, or temporary residue.
design_probes.success_witness: All 22 Oracle role identities reach three persistent collections; replay reaches 96 rows; IDM loss is present and Planner loss absent; schema 4 is completed with optimizer_owner=idm; strict reload reaches one finite [1,29] action; runtime closes once with no residue.

live_only_unknowns.fact: The exact server checkout and final walking, standing, twenty intermediate Oracle checkpoint, artifact-directory, and fresh output paths exist and can populate the v010 IDM-pretrain configuration without aliases.
live_only_unknowns.why_offline_impossible: Those files and filesystem identities exist only on the external server; local fixture paths cannot establish their presence, order, hashes, freshness, or write-boundary safety.
live_only_unknowns.falsifier: Wrong server checkout, any missing or duplicate checkpoint, fewer or more than twenty ordered intermediate checkpoints, non-fresh output, aliased paths, or unwritable artifact parent.
live_only_unknowns.cost: One read-only server inventory under /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal; expected under two minutes and no simulator or training process.
live_only_unknowns.stop_condition: Stop after printing checkout identity, ordered checkpoint paths with hashes, and target-path existence/parent permissions; do not create files or enter the environment.
live_only_unknowns.bounded_command: cd /ssd1/cyx/ICE-Cal && git rev-parse HEAD && find . -type f -name '*.pt' -print | sort
live_only_unknowns.output_path: captured Electerm terminal output for LIVE-SERVER-ASSET-IDENTITY
live_only_unknowns.zero_write_boundary: Read-only git and find operations only; no mkdir touch checkpoint creation environment construction simulator or training.

claims.scope: The unchanged local production main and persistent FADA composition route jointly execute Oracle source admission, replay, IDM-only update, and completion.
A completed schema-4 IDM checkpoint preserves phase and optimizer ownership through strict reload into the first finite action consumer.

negative_scope: No real server asset identity, MuJoCo behavior, GUI, long training, commit, push, or remote mutation is claimed.
LIVE_REQUIRED is not permission to train and authorizes no command until the human confirms the bounded server inventory.
R1 and R2 do not prove convergence, walking stability, calibration efficacy, or Planner readiness.
